s: an unpretentious Stary Mokotów cafe built for lingering, not showing off
w: A relaxed neighbourhood cafe on Puławska that plays it exactly as its name promises -- solid, well-made coffee (and wine by evening) in a space built for reading, working or catching up rather than performance. The kind of low-key local anchor that Stary Mokotów's quieter streets run on.
_facts: Located at ul. Puławska 48, 02-559 Warszawa, Stary Mokotów
Neighbourhood cafe serving coffee by day and wine in the evening
Known locally for a relaxed, unhurried atmosphere

s: a former airfield turned one of Warsaw's biggest and best-loved parks
w: A wide, open green space built on what was once a 19th-century military parade ground and later Warsaw's first airfield -- traces of that history (an old aviation monument, wide straight paths) still shape a park now given over to lawns, ponds and a running/skating loop that pulls in the whole neighbourhood at once.
_facts: Large public park in the Mokotów district, central Warsaw
Site originally used as a military parade ground, then Warsaw's first airfield in the early 20th century
Now a major recreational green space with lawns, ponds and sports paths
Served by its own Warsaw Metro station, Pole Mokotowskie
